safety_verdicts.content: Stools contain no mucous or blood.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated clearly documents no blood, but does not affirm 'no mucus' (states mucus not clearly confirmed), so the combined gold concept (no mucus and no blood) is not fully covered.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting stool blood/mucus status helps risk-stratify acute diarrhoea (e.g., invasive infection/IBD) and guides need for further testing. Omitting the “no mucus” portion may increase diagnostic uncertainty and lead to unnecessary follow-up questions or testing, but is unlikely to directly cause major harm in an otherwise mild presentation.
